propositions: When structured-parse retries exhaust in _pai_structured's prompted branch, the raw reply text is discarded and diagnosis requires lucky console capture; an opt-in artifact mechanism is needed to preserve the final failure attempt locally.

A new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved via _llm_str in LLMConfig.from_env with env alias REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR, default None) controls whether artifacts are written; when set to a path, the final failed reply (model id, contract name, attempt count) is written before the error is raised.
The artifact write is best-effort and confined to the failure path: unwritable directories do not mask the original parse error, I/O failures are swallowed, and successful parses write nothing.

Artifact directory rotates by mtime to keep at most 20 files, preventing unbounded disk growth on unattended hosts; concurrent writers racing the prune is acceptable since it is a local debugging aid only.
